sheets.name: README
rows: Traceability view for one regulation-to-SHACL generation run.
Generation is frozen before RDF execution; no ship graph or hidden expected outcome is used here.
events.jsonl is append-only; CSV and Excel sheets are derived views.
Static validation passed and the semantic validator accepted the candidate.
No verified canonical term was available; the generator was not allowed to invent one.
Accepted shapes await the separate bulk evaluator.

sheets.name: RUNS
rows: No candidate is semantically supported because the required canonical cross-owner relationship/path is absent; hullAreaValue is only a Class and the other candidates are quantities or unrelated classes.

sheets.name: ITERATIONS
rows: Reject: the ship-level SPARQL constraint is an inert accidental-pass check because it contains FILTER(false), and it also incorrectly attempts qudt:numericValue directly on the ship rather than on the shear-area QuantityValue; remove it or replace it with a real constraint.
